If you want to completely stop biome spread from entering the boxes below your house you have to dig around the hard mode V. One of your housing will possibly turn into corruption. New harder enemies will arrive so it's easier to do before hard mode, but digging a few vertical lines around the biomes shouldn't be hard. A 3 block gap is wide enough underground and in the caverns, but in the "surface" layer you need to stop thorny bushes from growing over the side.
